Subject: SIG v15 — change consolidation request & deadline

Hi Mina,

Acme is in the middle of an internal SIG refresh (we're moving to SIG v15) and our procurement/security team needs a consolidated set of re-answers and supporting evidence from Redwood that map to the v15 deltas. We've highlighted a handful of questions that changed (notably around key management and retention windows) and would like a single ZIP with: the re-answered questionnaire, a short diff summary pointing to changed QIDs, and any artifacts (config screenshots, KMS policy references, SOC reports).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- a consolidated re-answer file (CSV or XLSX) aligned to SIG IDs
- an evidence bundle with filenames that match the answers
- a short change-log mapping old->new answers (we only need the diff)

Target timing from our side is COB next Wednesday, Apr 21. If that won't work, let me know earliest we can deliver.

Thanks,
Michael Sullivan
Head of Security Operations
Acme Corporation

Michael —

Thanks for the heads-up and the timeline. We can support the consolidation request. Proposed approach from Redwood:

1) We produce a single SIG_v15_Reanswers.xlsx that contains the new v15 answers plus a column "previous_answer" for quick diffing.
2) We prepare an evidence rollup ZIP (named evidence_rollup_YYYY-MM-DD.zip) containing artifacts mapped to each QID.
3) We include a short human-readable change log (one-page) that lists QIDs with changed intent and a brief note of impact.

Immediate asks for your team: can you confirm which format you prefer for the change log (CSV vs single-sheet XLSX vs plain Markdown)? Also, do you want redlines on question-level edits or just the final re-answers/diff list?

Internal note: looping in Rishi for evidence collection and Karthik for KMS/retention confirmation. We'll target an internal cutoff for artifacts by Mon Apr 19 to give us two business days to assemble the bundle.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Thanks, XLSX is fine for the re-answers and a one-sheet change log (XLSX) would be ideal so our GRC tool can import it. We do want a redline-style diff at the question level where feasible (a short note per QID is OK).

Two quick clarifications:
- We flagged roughly 18 QIDs that changed semantics (I'll attach a short ChangeLog).
- For evidence mapping, please ensure filenames in the ZIP include the QID prefix (e.g., QID_3_2_kms_policy.pdf).

I'm attaching a brief changelog and a Google Drive folder with the official SIG v15 spec we're using. If you need a sample import template, say the word and we'll drop one into the Drive.

Appreciate it.

Michael
